claims.title: Exact comparisons acquire a hidden triangular decoder, while certifying its class promise can be exponential

status: Source-derived arguments and inspected producer replay; new extensions separately identified as integration-derived.
interface: Supplied complete hidden-affine triangular Boolean rank class with bounded total degree d and exact chosen-pair comparisons. Complete compact decoder, inverse and uniform arbitrary-prefix samplers are acquired. A new recognition lower bound compares against arbitrary permutation comparators; a standard repeated-comparison wrapper handles its explicit conditional noise promise. No general nonlinear learning or acquired real target.
limits: Seek specialist priority/proof review and strongest same-comparison tailored baselines; acquire a real target plus a structural class justification independent of cheap exact black-box recognition. Charge noisy/chosen-input accessibility, source preparation, transmission and storage. Extend beyond complete flags or design meaningful approximate testing without importing an exponential prefix table or treating a conjectured conditional sampler as established.
